description: An `if` condition reads a JSON-parsed integer too large for CEL's 64-bit `int`. Unlike `expect:`, `evaluate_cel`'s own conversion happens *inside* its `try`/`except`, so this is an ordinary `CelEvaluationError` (`CEL evaluation failed for '...': overflow`), propagated bare the same as any other condition evaluation failure -- no tool/use-style retry or `meta.error: "overflow"` special-casing applies here.
